RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

The panel's composition is not evidence of anything. All-female panels occur naturally, especially in ministries where women are well represented; the same logic would make the far more common all-male panel proof of bias against women. Nothing you've described points to discrimination: her political science master's plus international project leadership may simply have matched the role profile better than your (strong) generalist credentials.

Raising sex would likely be read as a sore loser's reflex and could damage your standing for future competitions.

Do pursue the substance: chase the written explanation in writing, citing any statutory deadline, and request feedback on your interviews. If the reasons given are evasive or shift, reassess then.
